sources.title: K. F. Roth, Rational approximations to algebraic numbers (reprint)
sources.locator: Roth reprint pp60–61, Taylor expansion properties A/B and inequality(4)
sources.summary: Small Taylor coefficients and vanishing of low-weight monomials yield the evaluation upper bound. Distinct nonvanishing condition is needed only when comparing the integer lower bound.

sources.summary: Weighted vanishing order compensates for unbalanced multidegrees; closeness of approximants gives an upper bound to combine with a nonzero rational evaluation lower bound.
